fact: A University of Sao Tome and Principe master's dissertation, reported by Tela Non, used national DHIS2 system data for 2022-2023 to compare hypertension, diabetes and stroke incidence across districts including Agua Grande, Lemba, Me-Zochi, Lobata and Principe.

UNDP Sao Tome and Principe published a notice (UNDP-STP-00136) on 29 April 2026 for a one-month independent evaluation of the country's health digitisation project, covering the effectiveness and sustainability of the DHIS2, mSupply and Instalacoes Inteligentes systems.
